line.name: Abuelo
line.description: 100% Honduran puro made entirely from tobacco grown on the Eiroa/JRE Tobacco Farm in Las Lomas, Jamastran, Honduras, and produced at Fabrica de Puros Aladino S.A. (Julio R. Eiroa's factory). Released June 2021. Vitola names form a family-relationship theme (Abuelo = grandfather, Padre = father, Nieto/Nieta = grandson/granddaughter).

research_notes: 'New Nieta' (folder photo UC-Abuelo_New-Nieta_Box-Open_01.jpg) could not be verified as a distinct vitola from 'Nieta' - likely the same product with updated box art or a re-photograph, not a separate SKU. Not added as its own vitola entry; flagged in image manifest instead. Sold in 20-count boxes.
